_help: Per-system hardening checklist. Weight w is 1-3; score = checked weight / total weight.

checks.why: The hypervisor controls every VM. One leaked password should not be enough.
checks.how: Datacenter > Permissions > Two Factor > Add TOTP

checks.why: A reused password here is the biggest single risk in the lab.

checks.t: Web UI not reachable from upstream
checks.why: Management should be reachable only from the lab or the tailnet.
checks.how: Check pfSense rules; from upstream: nmap -p 8006 <host> shows closed/filtered

checks.t: SSH keys only, password auth off
checks.why: Keys cannot be guessed. Test a key login before you turn passwords off.
checks.how: PasswordAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/; systemctl reload ssh

checks.t: Named admin user instead of daily root
checks.why: Audit logs show who did what.
checks.how: pveum user add <name>@pam; pveum acl modify / -user <name>@pam -role Administrator

checks.why: Hypervisor patches fix real escape bugs.
checks.how: apt update && apt full-upgrade; reboot if the kernel changed

checks.t: Backups run and one restore tested
checks.why: A backup you never restored is a hope.
checks.how: Datacenter > Backup; restore one VM to a new ID and boot it

checks.why: Gives you a rollback in seconds.

checks.t: Default-deny on the lab interface, rules reviewed
checks.why: Every allow rule is a decision. Review them like code.
checks.how: Firewall > Rules; delete or disable what you cannot explain

checks.why: Nothing in the lab should be published.
checks.how: Firewall > NAT > Port Forward should be empty

checks.t: Admin password unique, MFA where supported
checks.why: Firewall admin is the keys to the network.

checks.t: Admin UI only on the lab side
checks.why: The WAN side should never serve the admin page.
checks.how: System > Advanced > Admin Access; check anti-lockout rule

checks.t: Config backup exported and stored off the box
checks.why: Lets you rebuild in minutes.
Firewalls are targeted constantly.
You cannot hunt what you did not log.
checks.how: Edit the rule, tick Log packets

checks.why: Future you will not remember why.
checks.how: Add to the homelab repo changelog

checks.why: Domain admin is the end of the game if lost.

checks.t: Daily work done with a non-admin account
checks.why: Admin sessions leave credentials in memory.
checks.how: New-ADUser ...; add to Domain Admins only when needed

checks.t: Audit policy for logons and account changes on
checks.why: Events 4624/4625/4720/4728 feed Security Onion detections.
Server patches matter even in a lab.
Long passphrases beat short complex ones.
checks.how: Default Domain Policy > Password Policy; min length 14

checks.why: Old accounts are free footholds.
Blocks simple relay attacks.
checks.how: GPO: Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)

checks.why: AD is hard to rebuild by hand.
Protects data if the disk image leaks.

checks.t: Local admin password unique (LAPS or vault)
checks.why: Same local admin everywhere is lateral movement.
Free, decent baseline.
Most intrusions use patched-for-months bugs.

checks.t: RDP off, or reachable from lab only
checks.why: Exposed RDP is the classic way in.
Limits what a bad download can do.
Gives detections real process data.

checks.t: SSH keys only, root login off
checks.why: Cuts off password guessing.
The vulnerable apps must not reach out.
checks.how: pfSense rule: ubuntu to WAN blocked

checks.why: Patches arrive without remembering.

checks.t: Containers bound to the lab IP, not 0.0.0.0
checks.why: Keeps the vulnerable ports off other networks.

checks.t: ufw enabled with a short allow list
checks.why: Host firewall as a second layer.
checks.how: ufw default deny incoming; ufw allow from <LAB> to any port 22

checks.why: Slows guessing even from inside.

checks.t: Docker images pulled only during maintenance
checks.why: Reproducible and offline.
checks.how: Document the pull in the changelog

checks.why: Tools box with a weak login is a prize.
Written scope keeps you honest and legal.
checks.how: Create a notes file with targets and dates

checks.t: Only lab-owned targets in tool configs
checks.why: Prevents a typo pointing at someone else.
Tools change fast.

checks.t: Snapshot taken before big tool installs
checks.why: Easy undo.

checks.t: Logs of what you ran, kept
checks.why: Pair every test with the telemetry it made.

checks.t: Network isolated, never reaches the internet
checks.why: This box is broken on purpose. Isolation is the whole control.
checks.how: pfSense rule: meta to WAN blocked

checks.t: Only the kali host can reach it
checks.why: Keeps other lab VMs from being a path in.
checks.how: Check the lab rules table on ~/homelab

checks.t: No real passwords ever typed here
checks.why: Everything on this box should be considered public.

checks.t: Reset to a clean snapshot after each exercise
checks.why: So every run starts from the same state.
No traffic, no detections.
Holds your whole detection history.
Full disks silently drop logs.

checks.t: One test alert triggered per week
checks.why: Proves the pipeline works end to end.
checks.how: curl http://testmyids.com/ from a lab VM, then check Alerts

checks.why: New attacks, new signatures.

checks.t: Hunt hypothesis written down this month
checks.why: Hunts without notes are just browsing.
